summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns required by Hong Kong Exchange listing rules. The returns disclose routine daily share repurchases of ADSs representing Class A ordinary shares over multiple trading days in May and June 2026 at prices between USD 22.12 and USD 22.86. There is no change in total issued shares as repurchased shares are not yet cancelled. This is a routine ongoing share buyback program disclosure under HK listing rules, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural features. No risk-arb angle as this is a standard periodic reporting filing.
